questions.question: In a class of 45 students, a boy is ranked 20th. When two boys joined, his rank was dropped by one. What is his new rank from the end?
questions.solution:
Given:

Total strength of students = 45

Rank of a boy = 20th from one end.

∴ Rank from another end will be 45 - 20 + 1 = 26th

According to question:

Two boys joined, then total strength now = 47

Then, the rank dropped by one. This means one boy is ahead of him and another one is in behind.

His new rank from the end will be 26th + 1 = 27th

Hence, the rank of the boy is 27th.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d882eb53e1654572ea3dc666dcd3cad190f9f11ae417d152675fc91ed6bf6f2a.png] 

If rank from one side is given, then rank from another side will be:

Total strength - given rank + 1

questions.question:

4 + 9 + 3 = 16 = 4²

5 × 3 × 1 = 3 can be written as

5 + 3 + 1 = 9 = 3²

Similarly, 9 × 9 × 7 can be written as

9 + 9 + 7 = 25 = 5²

Hence, 5 is the correct ans.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All lotions are creams.

All creams are soaps.

No cream is a facewash.

**Conclusions:**

(I) No soap is a facewash.

(II) No lotion is a facewash.
questions.solution:
**Statements:**

All lotions are creams.

All creams are soaps.

No cream is a facewash.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0286b2de85a03b1ee42210dae5e83188c325dc19689f8a3855dc4716c5f7ce2a.png] 

**Check Conclusions: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ce17d39dd4e8e85827c996159d176a9464f7ec3e71368c8a7f34ad5a65560b7.png] **

**(I) No soap is a facewash**

We only know that creams are not facewash. But soaps may contain items other than creams. So soaps could still be facewash.

Therefore, this **does not follow**.

**(II) No lotion is a facewash**

All lotions are creams and no cream is a facewash.

So lotions also cannot be facewash.

This **follows**.

**Hence, only Conclusion II follows.**

questions.question: If Jyoti is 15 ahead in rank from Pratyusha, who ranks 26th from last, then how many students are there in the class if Jyoti ranks 10 th in order of merit?
questions.solution:
Jyoti = 10th (from starting)

Pratyusha = Jyoti (10) + 15 = 25th (from starting)

Pratyusha = 26th (from last)

Total no. Of students = Rank from starting + Rank from last – 1

= 25 + 26 – 1

= 51 – 1

= 50

Hence, total number of students is 50

questions.question: If all the letters of the English alphabet are divided into two equal halves and the second half is written first followed by the first half, then which letter would appear at the ninth place to the left of the 15th letter from the right?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

The first half of the English alphabets are:

Left Side : **A B C D E F G H I J K L M **: Right Side

The second half of the English alphabets are:

Left Side : **N O P Q R S T U V W X Y Z **: Right Side

The second half is written first followed by the first half then the series will be:

**Left Side : N O P Q R S T U V W X Y Z A B C D E F G H I J K L M : Right Side**

Now, The 15th letter from the right is Y.

Left Side : N O P Q R S T U V W X **__Y__** Z A B C D E F G H I J K L M : Right Side

The Ninth place to the left of Y is P.

**​**Left Side : N O **__P__** Q R S T U V W X Y Z A B C D E F G H I J K L M : Right Side

Hence,** ‘P’ **is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding to/subtracting from/multiplying with 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(59, 71, 55)

(85, 97, 81)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: 2nd number − 1st number = 2nd number − 1st number = 12, and 3rd number = 1st number − 4

71 − 59 = 12 
3rd number = 59 − 4 = 55 

**(85, 97, 81)**
97 − 85 = 12 
3rd number = 85 − 4 = 81

3rd number = 78 − 4 = 74 

**Option 4) (99, 111, 95)**
111 − 99 = 12 
3rd number = 99 − 4 = 95 

Hence, the correct option is **"Option 4".**
